text:
sam: Heads-up: customer on canary reported duplicate token lines after a streaming retry + toolcall truncation. looks like provisional + confirmed both showed up on the invoice. anyone have quick theories?
irene: do you have the router logs or a request id? this smells like a route handoff where we fail to stitch provisional charges to the confirmed one.
sam: xreq=9f2a, initial route=us-west-a, fallback=us-west-b, resume_meta=rs-51. logs:```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] router(us-west-a): stream partial, toolcall(search) truncated, provisional_write tokens=34
[2026-03-20T14:02:13Z] router: fallback -> us-west-b resume_meta=rs-51 transfer_reason=circuit_breaker
[2026-03-20T14:02:13Z] serving(us-west-b): confirmed_write tokens=34
```
pete: interesting that token counts match but both persisted. our ledger key currently uses session_id+prefix; that breaks when router starts a new session on fallback.
hiro: short-term mitigation: add a console banner "Pending reconciliation: charges may be collapsed" for accounts that have provisional+confirmed within a short window. reduces CS noise.
irene: longer-term: propagate a resume_token/tracing_id across router handoffs and attach it to all provisional/confirmed ledger entries so the recon worker can dedupe. also record transfer_reason (capacity/circuit_breaker/quota_throttle).
sam: agreed. caveat: toolcall idempotency. if the toolcall was retried and actually executed twice (non-idempotent) we must not merge. need a dedupe heuristic: if resume_token matches and toolcall_idempotent==true or tokens identical and timestamps within TTL then merge.
pete: add to that: ledger merges must keep an audit trail: mark record as merged_to=<confirmed_id> rather than deleting. billing needs an auditable refund or adjustment path.
hiro: telemetry change: inference.events.v2 fields: resume_token, prev_route, transfer_reason, toolcall_id, toolcall_idempotent. keep optional. we'll need router, proxy, and serving to populate when available.
devex: UX ask: console should show "Merged charge (origin: us-west-a)" with a hover that lists transfer_reason and timestamps. short-term banner + support link is fine.
billing-bot: Incident created INC-2026-341 assigned eng-platform. link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-341 :rotating_light:
irene: RFC plan: (1) router preserves resume_token header and emits transfer_reason, (2) ledger index adds resume_token (optional field) so recon can query, (3) reconciler merges provisional->confirmed within TTL=45s using resume_token and toolcall idempotency checks, (4) console surfaces merged state and transfer reason.
pete: i'll own the ledger change and the reconciler prototype on staging. sam can validate with repro scripts. hiro can prepare telemetry PR. devex will do console mocks. irene will draft RFC and coordinate with Billing for audit requirements.
sam: thanks team. I'll attach the full request logs to the incident and push a repro script that forces a circuit-breaker fallback so we can test merge semantics. :thumbsup:
